description: Review, merge and fix GitLab merge requests without leaving BB. Each merge request opens on status cards that name what blocks it, counts approvals and 👍 reactions as review, and tracks cherry-picks to your release branch. Reply to, resolve and reopen threads, read a failed job's log and retry it, and see your commit heatmap on the new-thread page. Requires the glab CLI logged in to your GitLab host.
